# Vizogen

> Vizogen is an AI-powered Google Business Profile (GMB) automation platform, owned and operated by NG Marketing Solution, serving local businesses across India — including Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, Kolkata, and other cities.

## What Vizogen Does
- Automated Google Business Profile post generation and scheduling
- AI-powered review reply automation
- Magic QR for feedback and review collection
- Local search ranking tracking
- Multi-location Google Business Profile management

## Who It's For
Small and multi-location local businesses including gyms, salons, clinics, restaurants, bakeries, and service businesses looking to automate their Google Business Profile and improve local search visibility.
